initialization_pairing: Exact shared successful six-layer first-window backbone and original independently seeded predictor; same independently seeded Pe; constant and linear variants share every initial learned tensor
projection: learned bias-free D by D linear map; independent normal mean 0, standard deviation 1/sqrt(D)
embedding_source: attached original raw token embedding lookup, without scaling, normalization, dropout or added positions
execution: eager, no outer activation checkpointing or KV-cache decoding
nextlat_objective: unchanged original state CE plus weight-one latent SmoothL1
nextlat_target: final post-normalization backbone hidden states, unchanged target-only stop gradient

constant.timing: same coefficient at initialization and every training/evaluation/checkpoint update

linear.timing: set lambda(s) before training update s; evaluation and checkpoint s use lambda(s)
